text: [issue by angelitoo12314] ### Steps to Reproduce the Crash 1. Install the mod jei-1.21.1-forge-19.69.0.457 (I did it in a modpack) 2. Enter the game(in TLauncher in my case), then it will crash, ''Failed to create secure jar for ...\mods\jei-1.21.1-forge-19.69.0.457.jar'' - Invalid module-info: Package ### Mod Pack URL (Optional) _No response_ ### Mod Pack Version (Optional) 1.21.1 Forge (Charger Version: 52.1.20) ### Extra Notes (Optional) Here is a picture showing the error: ### Crash Report https://gist.github.com/angelitoo12314/f02631745e2cd9c0ba2fcf7bc6856c9a [comment by mezz-bot (collaborator)] 🚀 A fix for this issue is available in Just Enough Items version `19.70.0.461` for Minecraft `1.21.1` (NeoForge, Fabric, Forge).
